Privacy, in plain words.

These notes describe this website as delivered. They distinguish the website from the Q-ZIPS desktop application.

Your visit

This website does not include analytics scripts, advertising trackers, accounts, contact forms or file-upload tools. Its code does not set cookies or use browser storage. Fonts, artwork and scripts are served with the website rather than loaded from third-party services.

The hosting provider may process normal request information, such as IP addresses, requested URLs and browser details, to deliver and secure the site. If hosted on Netlify, its processing is described in Netlify’s privacy policy. This website does not promise that hosting access logs are disabled.

Your download

The installer is served directly from this website. Downloading it does not upload your personal files. Your browser and the hosting provider handle the request in the same way as other file downloads.

The desktop application

The Q-ZIPS installer was inspected for file size, version metadata, digital-signature status and SHA-256 checksum. It was not run, reverse-engineered or independently security-audited. Its telemetry, network behavior, data collection and retention practices have not been verified.

Statements about this website’s privacy do not establish the application’s privacy practices. Review any terms and privacy information supplied by Q-CUBIC in the installer or application before use.

Password protection

The product artwork advertises AES-256 password protection. This is a product feature statement, not an independent cryptographic assessment or a guarantee about every archive format.

Updates and contact

No public support address was supplied for this release. No email address or response commitment is implied. These notes should be updated if the site owner adds contact forms, analytics, accounts or other services.
